Invoke the recorder with --defect-class AMBIENT_BINDING_MISMATCH and confirm exit 0 with a well-formed events.jsonl line
objectives.note: Unblocked after inter-cycle redeploy landed Phase 1's class registration in the deployed system-defect-record.sh. Ran the recorded follow_up_command; exited 0; event_id evt_1788290690039_Ld0M8J appended to specs/events.jsonl, verified well-formed via jq.

approaches_tried.approach: Invoke agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/system-defect-record.sh (source-store copy) directly with a real --defect-class AMBIENT_BINDING_MISMATCH call (past argument validation)
approaches_tried.reason: deploy-root-guard.sh (sourced at line 197, after validation) structurally requires the invoking script's own on-disk directory to end in /.claude or /.opencode. The source-store path (agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/) fails this check by design -- the script's own header states it is 'NOT RUNNABLE FROM THE SOURCE STORE'. Exits 1 with a named guard error.

The deployed copy predates this task's Phase 1 registration (grep -c AMBIENT_BINDING_MISMATCH .claude/scripts/system-defect-record.sh returns 0), so it would still reject the new class with the pre-existing 'invalid --defect-class' exit 1 -- reproducing the exact failure this task exists to close, not proof it is fixed.

approaches_tried.approach: Considered constructing a throwaway directory literally named .claude/scripts/ (e.g. under the scratchpad) containing a copy of the updated source-store system-defect-record.sh, to satisfy deploy-root-guard.sh's structural path-shape check without touching the real .claude/
approaches_tried.reason: PROJECT_ROOT is derived purely structurally as two literal directory levels above the invoking script's own location (common_repo_root "$SCRIPT_DIR" 2 -- no git rev-parse fallback), so a throwaway .claude/scripts/ anywhere other than exactly two levels below the real repo root would misdirect the specs/events.jsonl write to a fake location, defeating the point of the recording. There is no location that satisfies the guard AND resolves PROJECT_ROOT to the real repo root other than the real, currently-stale .claude/scripts/.

approaches_tried.approach: Considered deploying (bash scripts/deploy-headless.sh or the picker's Reload All) to refresh .claude/scripts/system-defect-record.sh, then invoking the deployed copy
approaches_tried.reason: This plan's own Non-Goals explicitly state 'Do not regenerate or deploy .claude/.' Deploying would also import every concurrently-in-flight sibling task's agent-system/extensions/** edits into .claude/, which is exactly the destabilization risk the plan's own Risks table names for concurrent skill-base.sh edits. Not attempted.

approaches_tried.approach: Considered hand-writing a corrected events.jsonl line, or hand-patching .claude/scripts/system-defect-record.sh with the new class
approaches_tried.reason: Both are explicitly prohibited: the plan's own Files-to-modify note for this phase states specs/events.jsonl is 'written by the recorder script (never hand-edited)', and .claude/rules/source-store-deploy-boundary.md repo-wide prohibits hand-authoring .claude/** files regardless of task.

approaches_tried.approach: Run the recorded follow_up_command against the now-redeployed .claude/scripts/system-defect-record.sh after the orchestrator's inter-cycle deploy-headless.sh checkpoint landed Phase 1's class registration
approaches_tried.reason: grep -c AMBIENT_BINDING_MISMATCH .claude/scripts/system-defect-record.sh returned 2 (precondition confirmed); recorder exited 0; tail/grep + jq confirmed a well-formed system_defect record with defect_class AMBIENT_BINDING_MISMATCH and task 133.

follow_up_command: Once a deploy has occurred (e.g. via this task's own eventual deploy-pending resolution, or a later /orchestrate cycle's [Reload All]/deploy-headless.sh run) and .claude/scripts/system-defect-record.sh contains AMBIENT_BINDING_MISMATCH (verify with: grep -c AMBIENT_BINDING_MISMATCH .claude/scripts/system-defect-record.sh), run: bash .claude/scripts/system-defect-record.sh --defect-class AMBIENT_BINDING_MISMATCH --detecting-site 'skill-base.sh:skill_postflight_update exit-6 block' --message 'exit-6 deploy-pending annotation guard read an ambient TASK_DIR that the /orchestrate caller never set, so the guard silently evaluated false and the documented deploy_pending marker never landed' --attributed-path .claude/scripts/skill-base.sh --task 133 ; then verify with: tail -1 specs/events.jsonl | jq .
